name: train-cs-sk-xlmr-ce-r3-s1
description:
RQ6, second model family with the recipe GLiNER's stage B carried forward:
train-cs-sk-xlmr-ce with every CNEC 2.0 and UNER Slovak-SNK train example repeated
3× (6,924 of 26,924 examples with this seed, the rest 10,000 from each OpenPII 1M
split). Steps stay at 4,200 of 16 (about 2.5 passes), so the data mix is the only
change. With 3× real data every GLiNER seed found the REDACT record the 1× runs
miss. Trained on MetaCentrum (docs/metacentrum.md).
